root_cause.text: In KVM AMD nested virtualization, `svm_set_nested_state()` treated a failure from `nested_svm_load_cr3()` as a WARN-worthy bug even though userspace can legitimately create that failure by changing CPUID after restoring CR3, making the warning user-triggerable via the nested state restoration path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (WARN_ON_ONCE(ret)) goto out_free;` to `if (ret) goto out_free;` in `arch/x86/kvm/svm/nested.c`, and the CVE description states the WARN is “trivially easy to trigger from userspace by modifying CPUID after loading CR3,” showing the issue is the unconditional WARN in `svm_set_nested_state()` on `nested_svm_load_cr3()` failure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Handle nested_svm_load_cr3() failures without triggering a WARN_ON_ONCE warning.
intent_record.what: The code removes a blank line and changes the conditional after calling nested_svm_load_cr3() from `if (WARN_ON_ONCE(ret))` to `if (ret)`, keeping the same jump to `out_free` on error.
intent_record.how: The function still aborts and frees on a nonzero return from nested_svm_load_cr3(), but it no longer emits a one-time warning when that call fails; the error is handled silently instead of being reported through WARN_ON_ONCE().

vuln_statements.explanation: This line converted a legitimate failure return from nested_svm_load_cr3() into a WARN_ON_ONCE path. Because userspace can trigger that failure by changing CPUID after restoring CR3 during nested state restoration, the warning was user-triggerable and constitutes the vulnerable statement.

bic_trace_step.reason: The shown function body already contains the corrected placement of the CR3 reload. The vulnerable pattern described in the root cause was calling `nested_svm_load_cr3()` too early, before NPT was enabled, which could make its failure user-triggerable and treated as a WARN. In this snippet, that call has been moved to after `svm_switch_vmcb(svm, &svm->nested.vmcb02);` and `nested_vmcb02_prepare_control(svm);`, i.e. after the nested VM is being prepared. The earlier buggy block is gone: the old code that did `ret = nested_svm_load_cr3(...); if (WARN_ON_ONCE(ret)) goto out_free;` before guest-mode setup is removed, and the remaining call is in the fixed position. Therefore the vulnerable construct is absent here and the fix is already present.
